description: This file defines utility functions for error handling within the 'interactors' package, specifically for checking existing errors and aggregating errors from multiple sources.

methods.name: ExistingErrorOr
methods.description: Returns the existing error if it is not nil; otherwise, executes and returns the error from the provided function.

methods.name: AnyError
methods.description: Iterates through a list of errors and returns the first non-nil error found; returns nil if all are nil.
